subject: Post-demo: Redwood mutual action plan — owners & timing confirmation

Subject: Post-demo: Redwood mutual action plan — owners & timing confirmation

Hi Alison — great to meet you and the FinTract team earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our demo: 

- Scope: user-facing credit-assist prompts (validation + explainability) + internal query reranking for support docs.
- Goal: reduce manual review by 40% for customer onboarding flows.
- Proposed pilot window: 6 weeks (pilot -> eval -> production roll).

Attached is the Mutual Action Plan (MPA) we discussed with suggested owners and target dates. Can you confirm two things please: 1) who on your side will own the pilot (technical & product leads), and 2) whether the target start of the pilot (we suggested 2028-02-06) still works given your procurement timeline?

Attachments: FinTract_MPA_20280104.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

If it helps, we can push the pilot start by 2–3 weeks; wanted to lock owners first so we can reserve dedicated capacity.

Thanks — happy to sync live if you'd prefer.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Schedule a 15-min follow-up: https://cal.redwood.ai/logan/15

Thanks Logan — appreciate the recap and the MPA. I'm out of office for part of this week and looped in our product lead to review. Procurement is finalizing a vendor checklist which may push timelines a little.

I should have initial owner names by early next week but wanted to flag that procurement will likely want an updated MPA with the procurement contact and a copy of any standard NDA.

Thanks,
Alison

Hi Alison — following up to see if you had a chance to confirm owners. I re-attached a v2 of the MPA that adds optional procurement fields (contact, expected PO window).

Two quick options depending on how procurement lands: 
- Option A (preferred): pilot start 2028-02-06 — keeps our Q1 capacity allocation and ensures you hit the product roadmap milestone.
- Option B (flex): pilot start 2028-03-01 — gives procurement extra time but we may need to re-reserve capacity if delayed.

Would you mind confirming who will be the technical owner and the product owner by EOD Friday? If procurement needs an NDA, we can share our standard exec NDA today (I can loop legal) — I added a procurement row in the MPA v2.

Attachments: FinTract_MPA_v2_20280109.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
